reason: The reported 2.07 comes from an unadjusted regression, and it reproduces. Remote share is strongly correlated with pre-period firm size, age and prior patenting. Adding the pre-2020 controls cuts the estimate to about 0.7 (SE 0.23), roughly a third of the reported size. The report uses one specification, no controls and a trim, so its magnitude is confounded and overstated. The sign stays positive, but the reported effect size is not supported.
